info.title: HeyOtto Chat API
info.description: OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions and Conversations for HeyOtto. Authenticate with a consumer API key (`ak_â€¦`) minted in settings. Errors use the OpenAI JSON envelope (`{ error: { message, type, param, code } }`), not RFC 9457.

tags.name: Chat
tags.description: OpenAI-compatible chat completions. Ottoâ€™s server system prompt is the only system context.

tags.name: Conversations
tags.description: OpenAI Conversations CRUD plus items. `GET /v1/conversations` is a HeyOtto list of `source = api` threads. Adding items does not run Otto â€” continue with `POST /v1/chat/completions`.

tags.name: Models
tags.description: Available models. `heyotto` is the fleet-default alias; catalog ids are also listed.

message.description: Human-readable explanation of what went wrong.
message.example: Missing or invalid API key. Pass `Authorization: Bearer <key>`.

type.description: OpenAI error class. Branch on this plus `code`.

param.description: Request field that failed validation, when applicable.

model.description: `heyotto` uses the fleet default chat model. Any other value must be a catalog id from `GET /v1/models`. Gateway slugs are not accepted.

conversation_id.description: HeyOtto conversation id. Echoed so the client can continue after a create.

messages.description: Model context for this call (OpenAI-stateless). `role: system` is rejected (`invalid_request_error`, `param: messages`).

stream.description: When true, the response is `text/event-stream` with OpenAI `chat.completion.chunk` frames ending in `data: [DONE]`.

conversation_id.description: HeyOtto conversation to continue. Omitted creates a new conversation. Echoed on the JSON response.

temperature.description: Accepted for SDK compatibility; ignored. The server uses Ottoâ€™s configured sampling for the selected model. (`temperature`)

top_p.description: Accepted for SDK compatibility; ignored. The server uses Ottoâ€™s configured sampling for the selected model. (`top_p`)

max_tokens.description: Accepted for SDK compatibility; ignored. The server uses Ottoâ€™s configured sampling for the selected model. (`max_tokens`)

n.description: Accepted for SDK compatibility; ignored. The server uses Ottoâ€™s configured sampling for the selected model. (`n`)

tools.description: Not supported. Requests that include `tools` are rejected with 400 (`invalid_request_error`, `param: tools`).

functions.description: Not supported. Requests that include `functions` are rejected with 400 (`invalid_request_error`, `param: functions`).

tool_choice.description: Not supported. Requests that include `tool_choice` are rejected with 400 (`invalid_request_error`, `param: tool_choice`).

response_format.description: Not supported. Requests that include `response_format` are rejected with 400 (`invalid_request_error`, `param: response_format`).

role.description: Client messages may be `user` or `assistant` only. `role: system` is rejected.

content.description: Plain text, or an array of `{ type: "text", text }` parts.

conversation_id.description: Conversation id to continue. Same meaning as top-level `conversation_id`.

HeyOttoRequestExtension.description: HeyOtto-specific fields. Prefer top-level `conversation_id` when the SDK allows extra properties.

id.description: `heyotto` uses the fleet default chat model. Any other value must be a catalog id from `GET /v1/models`. Gateway slugs are not accepted.

post.description: OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions. `model` is `heyotto` (fleet default) or a catalog id from `GET /v1/models`. Client `role: system` messages, `tools`, `functions`, `tool_choice`, and `response_format` are rejected (`invalid_request_error`). Omit `conversation_id` to create a conversation; pass it to continue. Echoed on the JSON response. `stream: true` returns `text/event-stream` with `chat.completion.chunk` frames ending in `data: [DONE]`.

200.description: A `chat.completion` object, or (when `stream` is true) SSE `chat.completion.chunk` frames ending in `[DONE]`.

get.description: HeyOtto extension (OpenAI has no list-all). Returns `source = api` conversations for this key, newest first. Page with `after` (a conversation id), `limit` (1â€“100, default 20), and `order` (`asc` | `desc`).

schema.description: Number of objects to return (1â€“100). Default 20.

parameters.name: limit

schema.description: Cursor object id. Returns the next page after this id in `order`.

parameters.description: Cursor object id. Returns the next page after this id in `order`.
parameters.name: after

post.description: Creates a personal API conversation (UI-locked). Optional `metadata.title` and up to 20 initial `message` items. Items are stored only â€” they do not trigger a completion. Continue the thread with `POST /v1/chat/completions` and `conversation_id`.
Updates `metadata.title`. Other metadata keys are accepted and ignored.

delete.description: Deletes an API-created conversation owned by this key. Child-scoped keys soft-delete so parents can still review and restore in the family UI. Parent- and observer-scoped keys permanently delete (no restore UI for those threads). App-sourced conversations 404.

get.description: Returns the models available to this key. `heyotto` is the fleet-default alias; the rest are catalog ids accepted by `POST /v1/chat/completions`. `GET /v1/models/{id}` is not implemented.
